original.target_description: Interaction between childcare subsidies and migration background (born in Switzerland versus born abroad), alternative-specific conditional logit model 4; preference among childcare center, professional caregiver and family care. Sample: parents/household partners with at least one child in center-based care in Bern, Switzerland.

n.sample_role: Participants/respondents (parents or household partners), represented by 1620 alternative-level observations in the choice model.
n.exclusions: Table 4 uses 200 imputations of missing values, rather than listwise deletion. Section 3.3.3 reports 54 missing outcome observations and 38 missing ISEI values; these were imputed. No further exclusion is specified for this table.
n.location: p. 117 (PDF p. 8), Table 4, N (Observations) and note; p. 115 (PDF p. 6), section 3.3.3
n.quote: N (Observations) 1620 (540) … Estimates based on 200 imputations of missing values.

notes:
Original statistics quoted or pictured in the replication report are secondary and were not extracted. No target-specific narrative verdict located. Main ISEI effects use model 2; additional covariate models also printed. Numeric p not printed for these coefficients; no p inferred from absent stars.
Source follow-up: Published article title and authors match the assigned reference. Table 4 labels estimates as odds ratios. Parentheses give standard errors, not test statistics. No numerical p-value or explicit p-bound is printed for the selected unstarred coefficient; no p-value was calculated. Original-only validation: replication and reported_success were not examined. Section 4.1, p. 116 (PDF p. 7), states: “All three interaction terms are not significant”; this narrative does not supply an exact p-value or explicit numerical bound.
